feed.account.welcome.title: WELCOME
feed.account.welcome.intro: Create your MineFeed profile. Everyone sees your nick, change it any time. Your @tag is your unique profile address.
feed.account.welcome.session_lost: You were signed out on this PC — probably the recovery code was used on another PC. Sign in with the new code or create a new profile.
feed.account.recovery.title: RECOVERY CODE
feed.account.recovery.intro_new: Profile created! This recovery code is the only way to sign in on another PC or get your profile back after a reinstall. Save it: it won't be shown again.
feed.account.recovery.intro: Your new recovery code. The old one no longer works. Save this one: it won't be shown again.
feed.account.recovery.warn: Never share the code — it gives full access to your profile.
feed.account.recover.title: SIGN IN WITH CODE
feed.account.recover.intro: Enter your recovery code. Other PCs will be signed out and you'll get a new code.
feed.account.recover.replace: %s is signed in here now and will be replaced. Save its recovery code first if you want to come back.
feed.account.recover.label: CODE
feed.account.profile.title: PROFILE
feed.account.profile.tag_confirm: %s → %s. Next change will be possible in 14 days. Nobody can take the old tag for 7 days.
feed.account.profile.new_code_confirm: Your old recovery code will stop working. The new one is shown only once — save it right away.
feed.account.profile.logout_confirm: Sign out of %s on this PC? You can only come back with the recovery code. Without it the profile is lost.
feed.update.title: MineFeed: update available
feed.account.tag.claim: %s is your Discord name — you can take it
feed.account.tag.cooldown_claim: Right now you can only switch to %s
feed.account.lost_tag.toast: %s was taken by its Discord owner
feed.account.lost_tag.notice: %s was taken by its Discord owner. You can pick a new tag right away.
feed.account.discord.link_intro: Discord will open in your browser. Press Authorize and come back to the game — it picks up automatically. MineFeed only sees your Discord name: no email, servers or messages.
feed.account.discord.login_intro: Discord will open in your browser. If a MineFeed profile is linked to it, you'll be signed in on this PC. Your recovery code stays the same and other PCs stay signed in.
feed.account.discord.claim_confirm: Your Discord name is %s. Make it your tag? It becomes protected and the 14-day limit doesn't apply. If someone else has it, they get a similar one.
feed.account.discord.unlink_confirm: Your tag will no longer be protected and Discord sign-in stops working. Your recovery code keeps working.
feed.account.discord.err.taken: This Discord is already linked to another profile
feed.account.discord.err.not_linked: No MineFeed profile is linked to this Discord
